staged_defects.declaration: The graded defect is staged for this task, not an upstream verl bug. Upstream at this commit pushes updated actor weights to the rollout replicas after every optimization step (trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py calls checkpoint_manager.update_weights unconditionally); the workspace carries a lab throughput-experiment patch that adds a trainer.rollout_sync_interval knob (default 1) and skips the sync on non-multiples of the interval, so the resident rollout replicas keep serving with stale weights between syncs. The run script sets trainer.rollout_sync_interval=64.

thinning: Retained for the shipped defective run (seed 42, 70 steps): full metrics.jsonl (steps 0..70), train.log, data_prep.log, rollout dumps at steps 1/32/64/70, all six val_generations files (steps 0/15/30/45/60/70), and the offline W&B text metadata/logs (the binary .wandb file was dropped). evaluations/issue/reference/ carries the per-step metrics.jsonl of the other four evidence arms (control k=1 seeds 42/43, defective k=64 seed 43, ladder k=8 seed 42) plus a 120-step k=64 diagnostic long run and evidence_summary.txt tabulating the severity ladder and probe trajectories.
